cases.description: A consumer and its test directly import a changed function.
An imported function is renamed locally before use.
A caller invokes a changed function through a module-qualified name.
Impact propagates from a service through a facade to a test.
A subclass and its test depend on a changed base class.
Two modules expose the same leaf name, but an explicit import identifies the target.
Changing one duplicate leaf symbol must not affect a caller of the other module.
A package module uses a relative import from the changed sibling module.
A caller reads a constant imported from the changed module.
A route module depends on a decorator defined in the changed framework module.
A public API exposes a class from the changed model module in annotations.
A conventionally named test is relevant even without an import edge.
A partial filename token must not make an unrelated test relevant.
A dynamic getattr call is a labeled hard case for static analysis.
An isolated change should produce no affected source files or tests.
